Louis-Vincent Gave

Gavekal Research | 6 Nov 2026

The overarching theme of most of my recently published research (see Heads, Or Tails? and The Confluence Of Risks) and of my videos and podcasts (see London Conference and Shudders In The Tech Complex) is that investors were confronting a long list of binary choices which made deploying capital especially challenging.
